moments_region_2nd_rel_invar — 2D features op

• Data kinds: region → feature

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "moments_region_2nd_rel_invar", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: moments_region_2nd_rel_invar (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)
